title: EHR-RAGp: Prototype-Guided Retrieval of Longitudinal Electronic Health Records for Clinical Prediction Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.12335v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Electronic Health Records (EHR) contain rich longitudinal patient information and are widely used in predictive modeling applications. However, effectively leveraging historical data remains challenging due to long trajectories, heterogeneous events, temporal irregularity, and the varying relevance of past clinical context. Existing approaches often rely on fixed windows or uniform aggregation, which can obscure clinically important signals. In this work, we introduce EHR-RAGp, a retrieval-based framework that dynamically integrates the most relevant patient history consisting of diverse clinical event types. We propose a prototype-guided retrieval module that acts as an alignment mechanism and estimates the relevance of retrieved historical chunks with respect to a given prediction task, guiding the model towards the most informative context. translated_title: EHR-RAGp：面向临床预测模型的纵向电子健康记录原型引导检索
translated_abstract: 电子健康记录（EHR）包含丰富的纵向患者信息，被广泛应用于预测建模应用中。然而，由于患者轨迹较长、事件类型异质、时间不规律以及既往临床背景相关性各异，有效利用历史数据仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖固定时间窗口或统一聚合，这可能掩盖临床上重要的信号。在本研究中，我们提出了EHR-RAGp，这是一个基于检索的框架，能够动态整合由多种临床事件类型组成的、最相关的患者历史。我们提出了一个原型引导的检索模块，该模块作为一种对齐机制，评估检索到的历史数据块相对于给定预测任务的相关性，从而引导模型获取最具信息量的上下文。在多个临床预测任务和两个基准数据集上，EHR-RAGp表现一致……（注：原文摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 提出EHR-RAGp框架，利用原型引导的检索模块动态评估并整合多种临床事件类型中最相关的患者历史信息，从而提升临床预测模型的性能。
en_tdlr: EHR-RAGp is a prototype-guided retrieval framework that dynamically integrates the most relevant longitudinal patient history across diverse clinical event types to improve clinical prediction models.
